panels.description: Alex patches a ventilation line while Tomas coughs dust. Bi11bot projects a route beside them. Leave upper machinery space.
Bi11bot's amber eye and route projection show the safest path leaving Tomas behind. Leave upper space.
Alex rejects the projected route while Tomas grips the old key. Leave upper worksite space.
Bi11bot faces Alex and admits the prediction failed. Keep his posture open and non-menacing; leave upper space.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: The safest route leaves Tomas where he fell.
